text: The brazier holds one elemental seal and turns it into a standing blessing for everyone nearby. It is also the heart of every tablet rite.

pages.title: Lighting a blessing
text: Right-click the brazier with a seal to seat it. The seal is never used up; crouch with an empty hand to take it back.

Keep that seal's totem within **8 blocks**, and Pulse in the Lattice nearby. While anyone stands within **6 blocks**, the brazier spends **8 Pulse every two seconds** and blesses them all. With nobody near, it spends nothing.
A held redstone signal pauses it; stored Pulse is not dumped. A struck signal fires its seated rite (see [Rite Circle](rite_circle)).

pages.title: The blessings
text: - **Loom**: luck, and each beat threads **2 Pulse** into a carried Pulse Cell with room.

pages.title: Seals
text: Every seal starts blank: paper, a Spirit Shard and a Bone Chime make **two** Blank Seals.
Add dirt for Earth, charcoal for Fire, a water bucket for Water, a feather for Air, a Spirit Shard for Spirit, or Loom Thread and a Spirit Shard for the Loom.
Seals also go into charms and Rite Tablets. A tablet recipe always hands its seal back.
